title: Episode 44
logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

blocks.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:03.30) | End: (00:08.20)
"Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown."

Start: (00:08.60) | End: (00:11.40)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:08.60) | End: (00:11.40)

blocks.speaker: LORD STERLING (Snarls, Outraged):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:09.10) | End: (00:11.20)
"You have no authority!"

Start: (00:11.40) | End: (00:13.80)

blocks.camera:
Start: (00:11.40) | End: (00:13.80)
Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

blocks.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE (Cold, Definite):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:11.40) | End: (00:13.20)
"I have more than enough."

Start: (00:16.40) | End: (00:19.40)

Start: (00:19.40) | End: (00:22.00)

Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:25.20) | End: (00:28.00)
"Alexander... I thought you had died."

Start: (00:27.80) | End: (00:31.20)
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:27.80) | End: (00:31.20)
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:28.40) | End: (00:31.00)
"Do you know what this did to me?"

Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:32.40)
Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:32.40)
Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:31.20) | End: (00:32.40)
"I mourned you."

Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:34.00)
Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:34.00)
Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:32.40) | End: (00:34.00)
"I waited for you."

Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:35.80)
Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:34.00) | End: (00:35.80)
Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Heartbroken):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:38.80)
"For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."

Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:38.80)
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:35.80) | End: (00:38.80)
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.20)
Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:38.80) | End: (00:41.20)
Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:38.90) | End: (00:41.20)
"I never stopped loving you."

Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:42.80)
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:42.80)
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:42.80)
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:41.20) | End: (00:42.80)
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:46.40)
Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:46.40)
Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:44.20) | End: (00:46.40)
"You don't remember?"

Start: (00:46.40) | End: (00:49.00)
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:46.40) | End: (00:49.00)
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:46.60) | End: (00:48.80)
"I was supposed to be your Duchess!"

Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:51.00)

blocks.camera:

Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:49.20) | End: (00:51.00)
"You were never my Duchess."

Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:53.00)
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:51.00) | End: (00:53.00)
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:51.10) | End: (00:52.80)
"But I loved you!"

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting):
blocks.text:

"You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
